item.title: German court convicts Ukrainian man over parcel bomb plot linked to Russia
item.description: A German court on Tuesday handed a jail sentence of one year and three months to a Ukrainian man for spying for Russia and helping prepare possible acts of sabotage. item.title: 1556 reproducciones · 24 reacciones | 🔴"Estamos bajo la nieve y hace frío": Pasajera varada en La Cumbre pide ayuda urgente a las autoridades Varios pasajeros, entre ellos niños, adultos mayores e incluso mascotas, se encuentran varados y soportando bajas temperaturas tras una intensa nevada registrada en las últimas horas en la carretera que conecta La Paz con la región de los Yungas. Jenifer, una de las pasajeras atrapadas en las cercanías de la apacheta Kuntur Maya, muy cerca de la conocida parada “Cruz de la Pachamama”, lanzó un pedido de ayuda a las autoridades competentes. item.title: An empty bus pulled into Ridgland Farms in Wisconsin last week and emerged with more than 150 rescued beagles – who had never felt grass or fresh air in their lives. More than 2,000 beagles had been already rescued from the farm, a controversial biomedical research and breeding facility. CBS News' Adam Yamaguchi got to be there as the remaining dogs – many of them puppies – had their first taste of freedom. Many of the dogs were paralyzed with fear as they finally exited the cages they had been trapped in and entered the unknown world of caring human beings and safety. After protesters tried to break into the facility to rescue the dogs earlier this year, the facility decided to shut down its breeding operations. The remaining beagles were taken to Big Dog Ranch Rescue in Florida, where they will be put up for adoption. #beagles #rescue #dogrescue #dogs | CBS News

item.title: In 1885, New Zealand introduced hedgehogs to fight pests; today, they threaten native wildlife
item.description: European hedgehogs were brought to New Zealand during the 1800s to help manage garden pests. However, these spiky creatures now pose a grave danger to the country's unique wildlife. They feast on the eggs and young of various native species, significantly impacting fragile ecosystems, particularly those involving ground-nesting birds. As a result, ongoing conservation initiatives are prioritizing hedgehog removal to protect these threatened populations. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
